paragraphs: So Seder HaDorot cites him, in the name of the Rashba on chapter HaMegaresh.[^1]

notes.text: The heading leaves Chizkiyah untitled, abbreviates Chiyya’s title as R', and explicitly calls Kahana Rav. The source attributes the notice to Seder HaDorot in Rashba’s name on HaMegaresh; the historical Gittin chapter9 identification has not been independently checked here.
